data.title: Baidu’s Expanding AI Ecosystem Supports Buy Rating and US$154 Target
data.description:
Analyst Alicia Yap of Citi maintained a Buy rating on Baidu, with a price target of $154.00.

Alicia Yap’s rating is based on Baidu’s strengthening position across the AI technology stack, spanning chips, cloud infrastructure, models, and agents. The rollout of Ernie 5.5 Flash Preview, with improved speed, broader context, and lower inference costs, should enhance the company’s competitiveness in enterprise and consumer applications. Token Exchange also creates a structured channel for distributing model capabilities in China and potentially overseas, supporting Baidu’s expansion in model-as-a-service.

Baidu’s Qianfan and Baige platforms provide the infrastructure needed for companies to build and deploy customized AI agents, while applications such as DuMate, Kuku AI, Baidu Yijing, and Famou 3.0 offer additional commercialization opportunities. These developments suggest that Baidu is converting its technical investments into practical tools that can raise organizational productivity and generate new revenue. With improved AI positioning and an indicated potential share-price return of 93.1%, Yap maintained a Buy rating and a US$154 target price.

data.title: Moderna Maintains Hold Rating as Intismeran Execution Risks Offset Long-Term Oncology Potential; $260 Price Target Unchanged
data.description:
In a report released yesterday, Alec Stranahan from Bank of America Securities maintained a Hold rating on Moderna, with a price target of $260.00.

Alec Stranahan gave his rating based on several factors, including Moderna’s growing dependence on intismeran as its main source of future value and the need for successful results in kidney and bladder cancer. Although manufacturing appears increasingly manageable, individualized production, tissue-sample availability, and real-world treatment logistics still create execution risks that limit confidence in near-term commercial adoption.

The infectious-disease business is expected to become more financially self-supporting, while oncology programs beyond intismeran provide meaningful but longer-term upside rather than immediate earnings support. With the stock near the analyst’s unchanged $260 price target, the balance between promising clinical potential and unresolved development and launch risks supports a Hold rating.

According to TipRanks, Stranahan is an analyst with an average return of -3.1% and a 41.86% success rate. Stranahan covers the Healthcare sector, focusing on stocks such as Moderna, Revolution Medicines, and Erasca.

In another report released on November 9, Morgan Stanley also assigned a Hold rating to the stock with a $95.00 price target.

data.title: Tom Forte Maintains Buy Rating and $22 Price Target on Rumble After Strong Q3 Beat and AI Growth
data.description:
In a report released yesterday, Tom Forte from Maxim Group reiterated a Buy rating on Rumble, with a price target of $22.00.

Tom Forte has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, including Rumble’s broad third-quarter beat on revenue and adjusted EBITDA, which marked the company’s first quarter of positive adjusted EBITDA. The newly integrated Quake AI segment contributed most of the quarter’s sales, demonstrating that the Northern Data acquisition can materially expand Rumble’s revenue base and strengthen its long-term position in AI and high-performance computing.

Management’s fourth-quarter outlook exceeded Forte’s initial forecast and pointed to substantial year-over-year growth, while expected demand for video data could create an additional opportunity through Rumble’s content assets and AI infrastructure. Forte also believes the company retains sufficient financial flexibility for strategic initiatives, and he maintained his 12-month price target at $22 based on an updated discounted cash flow analysis.
